examples.title: 星轨漂移美国 iOS 一周新增
examples.sql: SELECT event_date, product_id, platform, country_code, channel, new_users FROM daily_installs WHERE event_date >= '2026-10-06' AND event_date <= '2026-10-12' AND product_id = 'starlane_drift' AND platform = 'ios' AND country_code = 'US'

examples.title: 星云渠道实际成本与回收输入
examples.sql: SELECT event_date, channel, spend_usd, payback_usd, is_predicted FROM daily_unit_economics WHERE event_date >= '2026-10-06' AND event_date <= '2026-10-12' AND product_id = 'starlane_drift' AND platform = 'ios' AND country_code = 'US' AND channel = 'nebula_ads'
